reference.title: AEP Ohio electric bill (photo, front and back)
reference.description: Photo of a two-page AEP Ohio residential electric bill laid side by side on a table: the account summary with the amount due, a kWh usage-history chart, line-item delivery and supplier charges, meter-read details and a tear-off payment stub.

This document is a utility bill: a state.reason: An AEP Ohio residential electric bill: the utility's logo, an account number, a 29-day billing period, metered usage in kWh with a 12-month usage history, line-item delivery and supplier charges, the total amount due with its due date, and a tear-off payment stub.

criteria.name: This document is a utility bill: a statement from an electric, gas or water utility showing an account number, a billing period, metered usage and an amount due
